_comment: track is 'ai' (AI features) or 'web' (web development). Source of truth for the task board on aipath.sjapathway.com. To claim a task, open an issue titled with its id. Update status in the same PR that ships the work.

features.name: CV parser
features.summary: Turns a PDF, DOCX or text resume into structured JSON: contact details, sections, experience, education and skills.

features.name: Resume scorer
features.summary: ATS-style 0–100 score built from named checks, each with feedback the candidate can act on.

features.name: Skill matcher
features.summary: Compares a job description with a CV and shows matched skills, plus missing required and nice-to-have skills.

features.name: Interview question generator
features.summary: Role-aware questions that quote the candidate's own CV lines and probe the gaps against the job.

features.name: API & platform
features.summary: FastAPI service, clients, CI and this live site.

tasks.title: Baseline text parser
tasks.detail: Regex contact extraction, heading-based sections, taxonomy skills. PDF/DOCX via optional extras.

tasks.title: More section heading synonyms
tasks.detail: Recognise headings like 'Internships', 'Volunteering', 'Languages', 'Achievements' in SECTION_HEADINGS, with a test for each.

tasks.title: Structured experience entries
tasks.detail: Split the experience section into entries with title, company, start date, end date and bullets. Handle 'present' and month formats.

tasks.title: Structured education entries
tasks.detail: Extract degree, institution, graduation year and grade (GPA / percentage / class) from the education section.

tasks.title: Layout-aware PDF parsing
tasks.detail: Two-column CVs currently interleave text. Use pdfplumber word positions to read columns in order. Add fixtures.

tasks.title: Synthetic CV fixture set
tasks.detail: Write 20 varied, entirely fictional CVs (tests/fixtures/*.txt) covering different fields and formats. No real personal data.

tasks.title: Name extraction with spaCy
tasks.detail: Fall back to spaCy PERSON entities when the first-line heuristic fails. Keep spaCy an optional extra.

tasks.title: Explainable six-check scorer
tasks.detail: Contact, sections, length, action verbs, quantified impact, skills/job keywords. Each check returns points and feedback.

tasks.title: Detect weak bullet openers
tasks.detail: Flag bullets starting with 'Responsible for', 'Worked on', 'Helped with' and suggest a stronger verb. Grow ACTION_VERBS.

tasks.title: Calibrate check weights
tasks.detail: Collect recruiter ratings for the fixture CVs and fit the weights so the score correlates with human judgement. Document the method.

tasks.title: ATS-unfriendly formatting check
tasks.detail: Detect tables, text in images, headers/footers and unusual fonts in PDF/DOCX uploads and report them as a check.

tasks.title: Rewrite suggestions for weak bullets
tasks.detail: Rule-based first: for bullets with no metric or verb, return a suggested template ('<Verb> <what> by <metric>').

tasks.title: Grow the skills taxonomy
tasks.detail: Add data science, frontend, cloud and security skills with aliases to aipath/data/skills.json. Add a test for any tricky alias.

tasks.title: 'X or Y' requirements
tasks.detail: 'PyTorch or TensorFlow' should be satisfied by either. Treat alternatives as one requirement group.

tasks.title: Semantic skill matching
tasks.detail: Use sentence embeddings so 'deep learning frameworks' partially matches PyTorch. Report exact vs semantic matches separately.

tasks.title: Years-of-experience extraction
tasks.detail: Parse '3+ years of Python' from job descriptions and estimate the candidate's years from dated experience entries (needs CV-3).

tasks.title: Required vs nice-to-have matching
tasks.detail: Weighted coverage score; optional skills count half. Lists matched, missing and extra skills.

tasks.title: Template question generator
tasks.detail: Behavioural, CV-grounded experience, gap and technical questions with answer guides.

tasks.title: LLM model answers grounded in the CV
tasks.detail: Add a provider-agnostic LLM step that drafts model answers using only facts from the CV. Include tests that reject invented facts.

tasks.title: Behavioural bank by seniority
tasks.detail: Add junior, mid and senior behavioural question sets and a 'seniority' parameter.

tasks.title: Role-specific technical banks
tasks.detail: Curated technical questions for ML Engineer, Data Scientist and MLOps roles, selected by the role string.

tasks.title: FastAPI service
tasks.detail: /parse, /parse/file, /score, /match, /interview and /health with OpenAPI docs.

tasks.title: Dockerfile for the API
tasks.detail: Slim Python image, non-root user, uvicorn entrypoint, and a README section on running it.

tasks.title: CI on pull requests
tasks.detail: GitHub Actions workflow running ruff and pytest on Python 3.10 and 3.13.

tasks.title: TypeScript client
tasks.detail: Typed client package generated from the OpenAPI schema, published under clients/typescript.

tasks.title: Request limits and rate limiting
tasks.detail: Cap JSON body size and add per-IP rate limiting middleware with tests.

tasks.title: Live site with demo and task board
tasks.detail: aipath.sjapathway.com on Cloudflare Workers, rendering this file.

tasks.title: Python ↔ JS parity tests
tasks.detail: The browser demo is a JS port of the Python engine. Add shared fixtures and a test that both produce the same results.

tasks.title: Run the Python engine in the browser
tasks.detail: Replace the JS port with Pyodide loading the real aipath package, so the demo can never drift.
